gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU execution was used because the defect is in CPU-side Pydantic request normalization. The MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3 weights and the reported TP=4 configuration were unavailable; a tiny Llama transport fixture cannot qualify MiniMax-M3 template semantics.

remaining_limitations: No end-to-end MiniMax-M3 generation was run because the model weights and reported four-GPU topology were unavailable.
The single assigned gfx950 cannot reproduce the issue's TP=4 launch, and no smaller fixture is claimed as a model-level reproduction.

reasoning_effort=none remains a separate generic compatibility path: it sets thinking and enable_thinking booleans, while MiniMax-M3 consumes thinking_mode. This change is intentionally limited to the official MiniMax thinking field requested by the issue.
